name: Gateman – Simple Login Registration
author: JK

sections.description: Simple Login Registration plugin with only login, registration, password recovery and related features. If you don’t need heavy stuffs like membership, profile etc, then it is ideal for you to keep your site smooth.
sections.changelog:
= 1.0.1 – Nov 19, 2025

New: Login
New: Registration
New: Password reset
New: Replace WP login page
New: redirect_to URL parameter support
New: Filter and action hooks for high flexibility

short_description: A lightweight login and registration plugin designed without unnecessary bloat. Just the essential features you need for a smooth user experience.
description: Simple Login Registration plugin with only login, registration, password recovery and related features. If you don’t need heavy stuffs like membership, profile etc, then it is ideal for you to keep your site smooth.
